title: A Visit to the City Museum
text:
Our city museum has a new brochure for visitors. The brochure has a map of the museum and a list of the rooms. It also shows the opening times, from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Every Monday the museum is closed.

The brochure has information about the tickets too. A child's ticket costs five pounds, and an adult ticket costs ten pounds. On weekends, visitors can get a free guide at the front desk.

questions.text: What does the brochure include about the rooms?
options: A map and a list of the rooms

questions.text: Why would a family read the brochure before they visit?
options: To find out the opening times and prices
To learn how to paint pictures
To book a hotel room nearby

questions.text: What can we infer about visiting the museum on a Saturday?
options: A guide may help visitors for free
The museum is closed all weekend
Children are not allowed to enter

vocabulary.definition: a small printed booklet that gives information
a drawing that shows the places in an area
a small paper or card that allows you to enter a place
a person or booklet that helps visitors learn about a place

paragraph_translations: Şehir müzemizin ziyaretçiler için yeni bir broşürü var. Broşürde müzenin bir haritası ve odaların bir listesi bulunuyor. Ayrıca açılış saatleri de gösteriliyor, sabah 9'dan akşam 5'e kadar. Her Pazartesi müze kapalıdır.
Broşürde biletler hakkında da bilgi var. Bir çocuk bileti beş pound, bir yetişkin bileti ise on pound. Hafta sonları ziyaretçiler ön masadan ücretsiz bir rehber alabilir.
